native_systemd.head: debian-package-smoke
checks: legacy: with an unchanged config.toml (keypair_path) and no signer.toml, provisioning leaves the key with the daemon user (0600), which keeps reporting

migration: after switching config.toml to the service signer, the daemon restart handed the same key to suifleet-signer (0600) without a reboot; address (0xa0ccc8bcc8…) and journal unchanged; the unit recorded its MainPID as root

component process (daemon user, shipped sandbox): device.key and signer.toml unreadable (EACCES); signer processes invisible; no key material in env or inherited fds; the daemon's environ and descriptors unavailable (FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/proc/652/environ'; PermissionError: [Errno 1] pidfd_getfd: Operation not permitted); report and telemetry signing refused (not the main process); only the public address served
the daemon's status report was signed by the service and accepted by the shim's signature verification
reports keep being signed after the signer and the daemon restart; the refused component request is logged

a component killed the daemon and, reparented to PID 1 in suifleet.service's cgroup, made 8 signing requests (ppid 1, unit cgroup verified as root): all refused as not the recorded main process; the restarted daemon reports again

hijack: component-written launcher state naming its own executable is ignored (the real binary refuses [daemon_update] with the service signer; the restarted main process is /usr/bin/suifleet and reports); a main process running that executable (a full daemon) is not recorded by the root recorder ('not running the base binary'), and its otherwise valid report request is refused; the queued report is signed only after the base daemon runs again
real live-package upgrade stopped daemon/signer/socket without auto-restart; identity/configuration/journal preserved; explicitly restarted services signed a new report
